name: form-section
title: Form section
description: A fieldset with a legend, help text and a Required or Optional note, stacked or split into a sticky title column and a card of fields.
docs: title is the legend, so a screen reader names the group before the first field; description and the requirement note (required or optional) describe it through aria-describedby. layout is stacked (title above the fields, the default) or split (title and help in a left column that is sticky on wide screens, the fields in a bordered card on the right); both are one column below 48rem of the section's own width, so also at 320px. error is a problem with the group as a whole: it renders above the fields with role alert and is tied to the fieldset; errors of one field belong to that field. disabled is the native fieldset attribute and switches off every control inside, the footer included; only the title is dimmed, because the note and the help beside it say why. footer is a slot for a section-level action such as Save. divided (default true) draws a hairline and a fixed space above every section after the first, so sections placed one after another read as one column. The legend is floated: that makes it an ordinary box beside the fields instead of the browser's special one on the border, and the fieldset contains the float. labels carries the words Required and Optional.
